name: status-burn-in-hand-end-turn-seed0
description: sts2-rs-8z3fl.11: Burn (Status, cost=-1, unplayable) end-turn-in-hand tick. Player starts a round with a single BURN in hand and immediately ends turn. The end-of-turn `register_turn_end_in_hand_hook(CardId.BURN)` fires, dealing BURN_DAMAGE=2 unblockable-style damage to the owner (sts2-rl-agent@01c094d:sts2_env/cards/status.py:1373-1383 + core/constants.py BURN_DAMAGE=2). Verifies that (a) the engine surfaces the card as `playable: false` on the initial bridge state because cost=-1, (b) the end-turn tick deals exactly 2 damage to the player (80 → 78), and (c) Burn moves to discard (not exhaust — Burn is NOT ethereal, unlike Dazed). Pairs with `ethereal-dazed-expel-seed0` which covers the ethereal-vs-discard distinction. ShrinkerBeetle is the empty-encounter sentinel reused from the Dazed fixture.

compare.exclude_fields_reason: Cross-language RNG (Python MT vs Rust Xoshiro256++) — intent triple diverges by design (monsters.rs:22-29). The Burn end-turn-in-hand tick does NOT consume RNG, so player HP + pile counts + hand shape stay byte-equal.
